git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix cache corruption from concurrent access

The CacheStore used bare fs::write() for both content and metadata
files, which caused corruption when multiple processes accessed the
cache simultaneously. Readers could see partially-written files
(torn reads), and concurrent writers could interleave content and
metadata writes, producing mismatched state.

Apply two defenses borrowed from state/store.rs patterns:

- Atomic writes via write-to-temp-then-rename for every file write,
  so readers never observe partial content.
- Per-entry exclusive file locking (fs2) so concurrent writers
  serialize on the same cache entry.

Add CacheStore::update_with_content() to let callers atomically
update both content and metadata under a single lock, and migrate
CacheRevalidator to use it instead of direct fs::write + update.
EOF
)"
